messages:
joel_s: Heads up — Kepler Health asked for a short trial. Need to map the trial scope and agree success criteria. Can we sync on the 3 core journeys they care about?

maria_g: Yep. From the call: 1) clinical triage assistant (structured summary + risk flagging), 2) visit note draft generator (from conversation + vitals), 3) patient Q&A (HIPAA-safe chatbot).

samir_k: Quick clarifying Q: for triage, do they want real-time streaming responses or batched summarization? That impacts latency SLOs and model choice.

joel_s: They said real-time-ish for triage (sub-1s token stream preferred) but note gen can be async. We'll propose streaming for endpoint A and async for B/C. @katie_p can you confirm infra feasibility?

katie_p: Streaming for triage is doable with hosted API + dedicated pool for the POC. Recommend: route triage traffic to a low-latency host + prefix KV cache for repeated context. Cost estimate will depend on predicted qps.

chao_l: From security side: they require data residency (EU), KMS integration, and no logging of PHI by default. We'll need Private or Dedicated with VPC.

maria_g: Noted. Also they want a 2-week trial window, with two customer-provided eval prompt sets for each journey. Success metrics: precision of triage flags >= 88% on their test set, note quality rating >= 4/5 by clinicians, p50 latency < 300ms for triage in-region.

samir_k: For prompts/evals I suggest we ask for 50 representative examples per journey and do A/B vs their current baseline. We'll include deterministic eval harness and synthetic augmentations.

joel_s: Action items: 1) SE (samir) to prepare prompt templates + eval harness. 2) Infra (katie) to propose deployment (hosted vs dedicated) cost delta and capacity estimate. 3) Security (chao) to list required controls and gaps. 4) Sales (me) to draft SOW + pricing.

maria_g: I'll also stub endpoints & sample payloads. Draft:
```
POST /v1/kepler/triage
{
  "patient_conversation": "...",
  "recent_vitals": {...},
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "stream": true
}
```

katie_p: For dedicated estimate: assume peak 40 qps, avg request 200 tokens in /triage. Suggest 2x gpus on the dedicated pool for redundancy. Ballpark delta vs hosted ~+35% on committed monthly. I'll send numbers.

chao_l: Security Qs they raised in RFP: SOC2 + ISO27001 status, data deletion policy, MFA for console, SSO (SAML/OAuth), network egress controls. We also need to confirm if audit logs can omit request bodies for PHI.

samir_k: On model selection: propose a quantized LLM variant for triage (low-latency) and a higher-capacity model for note gen. We'll include a fallback policy: if latency exceeds threshold, route to cheaper/fast variant with degraded summary quality. Need to show rollback plan.

joel_s: Pricing ask from customer: trial usage cap 500k tokens. They want a clear overage rate. I'll propose trial flat fee + consumption buffer. Any objections?

maria_g: Sounds fine. Recommend we include a simple KPI dashboard for them showing token usage, latency percentiles, and eval scores daily. That helps their PM show value.

katie_p: Deploy-bot: reserving staging capacity now...

deploy-bot: reserve-capacity triggered by katie_p — dedicated-poc-staging created (id: dp-kepler-stg).

chao_l: One enterprise blocker flagged by their security team: requirement for customer-managed keys in HSM. That will push them to Private deployment unless we can get an exception. Flagging for legal review.

samir_k: For eval pass/fail: we should define thresholds per journey in the SOW. Example: triage flag F1 recall >= 0.85 and false positive rate <= 0.15; note gen mean clinician score >= 4.0. If either fails, we offer 2-week tuning window.

joel_s: Timeline proposal: Week 0 — SOW sign + baseline data; Week 1 — infra + model config ready; Week 2 — trial run with eval set; Week 3 — final report & decision. Need sign-off from Kepler by EOD Thurs.

maria_g: I'll draft the endpoint matrix and the SOW language. Leaving detailed prompt examples and eval rubric to samir.

katie_p: I'll attach capacity/cost estimates and quick runbook for switching to Private if HSM is required.

joel_s: Great. @maria_g @samir_k @katie_p @chao_l please reply here when your artifacts are uploaded. I'll consolidate and send to Kepler. :+1:

maria_g: Uploaded endpoints matrix to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/kepler/poc/endpoints.csv

samir_k: Eval harness link: https://ci.redwood/tests/kepler-evals (contains scripts + expected metrics)

katie_p: Cost sheet posted in the same folder.

joel_s: Thanks team — will send initial SOW today and request their sample prompts.

chao_l: One last note — legal asked we avoid storing full patient identifiers in logs. We'll add that to the SOW as explicit clause.

joel_s: Noted. Closing this thread for now, will reopen if Kepler requests changes.
